reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and getNextDate and adds shared predicates (isDailyWeekendSkip, isWeekendOrHoliday), but schedule-template builds its own getAdjustedDate closure instead of calling the new getWeekendAdjustedDate, and app.ts gets its own applyWeekendHandling rather than a shared occurrence-adjustment helper.

duplication.why: Collapses schedule-template's two inline copies into one closure, but that closure re-implements getWeekendAdjustedDate, and the daily skip-weekend filter is written twice (a .find in getNextDate and a .filter in applyWeekendHandling).

placement.why: The weekend/holiday rules sit in shared/schedules.ts where the tree keeps them; applyWeekendHandling and the shift-padding heuristic live in server/schedules/app.ts although they are general recurrence logic.

scope.why: Changes stay on schedule weekend/holiday handling and the new handler; parseRecurDate is extended with frequency and holidays to feed it, which is needed.

maintainability.why: Daily-skip semantics are spread over three places with a magic look-ahead of 7 and a padding of 2 + 2*holidays, and schedule-template now flips getNextDate's noSkipWeekend flag to mean 'skip daily weekends', which overloads that parameter.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts getAdjustedDate re-implements getWeekendAdjustedDate (shared/schedules.ts) inline; app.ts applyWeekendHandling filters daily weekend/holiday days itself instead of sharing getNextDate's logic.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily weekend/holiday skip appears as a .find over occurrences in getNextDate and as a .filter in applyWeekendHandling (app.ts); schedule-template's getAdjustedDate closure is the body of getWeekendAdjustedDate under another name.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily-skip branch (look-ahead take and a skip filter, with a !skipDailyWeekend guard on the move); schedule-template.ts getAdjustedDate and app.ts applyWeekendHandling re-implement the adjustment/skip outside the shared helpers.
